info.title: Twilio API definition for public-api voice

voice.v2.configuration.transcription.par.description: Default participant role and channel mapping for diarization and implicit participant creation.

audioChannelIndex.description: One-based index of the audio channel in a multi-channel recording associated with this role.

type.description: The participant role to apply when inferring participants.

voice.v2.configuration.transcription.sta.description: Callback configuration for notifications when transcription is complete.

method.description: The HTTP method to use for the webhook callback.

voice.v2.configuration.transcription.con.description: Configuration for Twilio Voice Transcription Service. Either transcriptionStatusCallback or conversationConfigurationId (or both) must be provided.

configurationType.description: The configuration type discriminator. Always "Transcription" for this resource.

transcriptionEngine.description: The transcription engine provider. Supported values: 'google', 'deepgram', 'twilio_managed'. When using 'twilio_managed', do not specify a speechModel.

speechModel.description: The specific speech model to use for transcription. Valid models depend on transcriptionEngine: For 'google': chirp_2. For 'deepgram': nova-3, nova-2. For 'twilio_managed': twilio_managed.

language.description: Controls how the ASR handles language. Can be a supported BCP-47 language code, or 'multi' for multilingual code switching (Deepgram engine only). Supported language codes: en-US, en-GB, en-AU, de-DE, fr-FR, it-IT, es-MX, es-ES, es-US, pt-BR, pt-PT, nl-NL, no-NO, pl-PL, sv-SE, da-DK.

conversationConfigurationId.description: The ID of the Maestro Conversations Configuration for transcription storage and optional add-ons.

participantDefaults.description: Default participant roles and channel mappings for diarization and implicit participant creation. Must include exactly 2 participants mapping audioChannelIndex 1 and 2.

voice.v2.configuration.transcription.req.description: Request body for creating or updating a Transcription Configuration.

voice.v2.configuration.transcription.res.description: Response body for a Transcription Configuration.

channels.description: The number of channels to be composed.

trim.description: Trim the silence in the recordings.

track.description: The audio track to record for the call.

voice.v2.configuration.recording.status_.description: Callback configuration for a recording status.

voice.v2.configuration.recording.feature.description: A feature to apply to a recording.

voice.v2.configuration.recording.configu.description: Configuration for Twilio Voice Recording Service.

configurationType.description: The configuration type discriminator. Always "Recording" for this resource.

features.description: The features to apply to this recording.

voice.v2.configuration.recording.request.description: Request body for creating or updating a Recording Configuration.

voice.v2.configuration.recording.respons.description: Response body for a Recording Configuration.

voice.v2.account_default_configuration.r.description: Request to create or update an account-wide default Recording configuration.
Response for an account-wide default Recording configuration.
